notes.title: v3.1.8 update announcement:
notes.content:
v3.1.8 update notice:

This update fixes an initialization error caused by Windows localized strings. This error was causing the game to freeze for players in some regions when selecting specific characters. The 3 affected characters - Tokoroa, Emy, and Panda - can now be selected for playthroughs as intended!

If you encounter any in-game errors such as game crashes, issues launching the game, etc., please send a detailed description of the error or screenshots to juicyrealm@xd.com. These bug reports will help us address such errors more effectively. We appreciate your support!

notes.title: New content, new characters, and crossplay coop triple update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We have prepared some juicy presents for you! Imagine you are playing Juicy Realm on your PC and your girlfriend is playing on her NS/mobile on the sofa, you can enjoy a heartwarming coop experience on two different platforms. Sorry if you don’t have one, but having Crossplay coop on Juicy Realm would definitely help! :P

Other than crossplay coop, we are also including the contents from other platforms. Now players on all platforms have the same contents, Juicy Realm is finally an adult! Thank you all so much for the support along the way!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31068769/39ad967d0612a8e25e94058e36b7f77c4bbed04c.png
Here are the update details:

1. Added Lan Crossplay coop mode, now you can play coop mode with players on other platforms!
2. Added a backpack system and improved the weapon update mechanic. You may equip and unequip weapon attachments freely.
3. Added a new Character--Lily. To unlock her, you will need to beat the game with 6 stars challenge mode.
4. Bigger map display and you will be able to fast travel to rooms you have been to.
5. Added "Info" menu. You can access stage and ability information here.
6. 20 NEW weapons!
7. Added a new feature that allows you to trade hp for items.
8. Improved the statue room types.
9. Improved the pet skills.
10. Improved the guaranteed drops for the washing machine.

Improvements:
1.Same attachments will automatically merge into better attachment. Each top attachment has its own powerful ability.
2.Improved the pet skills.
3.Now you will get more loot drops after the washing machine explosion. 

[previewyoutube=MgAQO7GBD-U;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Juicy Realm just turn two years old!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Long time no see!

Juicy Realm is now two years old! Thank you all so much for supporting us through these two years. The game would never improve so much without your support.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31068769/5851c82b19f9216e20c358a4e6429759c2fd9b0c.png
When Juicy Realm launched on PC, we attracted quite a few players with the unique art-style and rich details. But there were a lot of problems with the game and the reviews were not great. Since then, we have made a lot of changes to the game. It was a long journey to how it is now, and to be selected for the Golden Hall of Fame by Famitsu.

We have much good news for you on this special anniversary.

For celebrating the two-year anniversary, we have put out historical low price sales for Juicy Realm. 50% off for PC version, 35% off for Switch. If you haven't bought the game, now is your chance! See how much we have changed the game!

Also, Juicy Realm will be released on Mobile on May 4th!

New content for the mobile version:
1. Added a backpack system and improved the weapon update mechanic. You may equip and unequip weapon attachments freely.
2. Added a new Character--Lily. To unlock her, you will need to beat the game with 6 stars challenge mode.
3. Bigger map display and you will be able to fast travel to rooms you have been to.
4. Added "Info" menu. You can access stage and ability information here.
5. 20 NEW weapons!
6. Added a new feature that allows you to trade hp for items.
7. Improved the statue room types.
8. Improved the pet skills.
9. Improved the guaranteed drops for the washing machine.

After the mobile release, we will work on transplanting the new features to the PC and Switch versions. So please don't miss out on this great 50% off opportunity to purchase the game!

Juicy Realm turns Two years old now, the birthday cake is 50% off sale! Come and see how we have improved through the years!

notes.title: A wild HUGE update has appeared!! New stage, new character and more surprises!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Seeing this post before the Spring Festival, I’m sure you guys already know what’s going to happen! 
 
Yes, when the game released on Switch, we promised to bring this part of the update to the PC version after three months.  Where are the better timings than releasing these updates on Spring Festival! We are going to release the switch updates with some newly developed features! 
 
To those who haven’t played the NS version, allow me to introduce the BOSS RUSH mode. Now you can enter the hidden lair of Bosses and start a non-stop battle with them. All the Bosses and Elites that you encountered before will show up in teams, and various brutal combinations will appear.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31068769/75a46d39ad721ded0bb121f8ea1cea52f4d62cbc.png
 
In addition, you can also use a brand new combat robot that is good at using various energy weapons. It can also form a bullet shield to protect you and your teammates.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31068769/896d4721fdc01592e0d984d7f33d295a649008ef.png

As for the Spring Festival update, we also doubled the number of rooms for all levels. Yes, we doubled it! We also added some new traps to these new rooms. Now, not only you need to deal with the enemies, but also remember to be careful of the various traps in the stages.

Also, we have added a new level and new enemies that you have been waiting for.
In this fifth level, you will see various venom traps, enemies with invincible shields, and cherries that look vulnerable but actually very brutal.


Finally, as an Easter egg of the Spring Festival update, we have added a firecracker weapon. You can now use these firecrackers to blow up cute and annoying fruits!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31068769/4bceb31ea53e6cd52ffb06dcf26ae76db10a0147.png

In fact, there are still plenty of improvements besides those. For example, many players said that some room exits are difficult to find, and now there will be more indications for all the exits; some character skills are pretty lacking, so we have allowed some characters to use their skills multiple times; the sprint stamina system was not clear enough, so we redesigned and improved the UI; the field of view of the challenge was kind of awkward, so we improved it to behave similar to the fog of war mechanic, etc.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31068769/d90a85a4890da6379dc207a7e6f2fd2f75c9a107.png

The most important thing is that these contents will be available as soon as you update （v2.4.0）them, and you don't have to purchase a DLC or pay additionally. Why haven’t you bought the kind-hearted game already?? XD

 『The Spring Festival Special Discount』
1.23-1.27 Steam 30% off
 
Now the European version on Switch already has a 20% off discount. All of the above content will be updated to the Switch version, too. But since submitting the update to Nintendo would take a bit longer, if you want to experience the new content during the Spring Festival, the PC version would be a good choice.

notes.title: Juicy Realm Update Patch v0.1
Welcome to Juicy Realm 2.0
notes.content:
Sorry for keeping you guys waiting for such a long time. We finally accomplished Juicy Realm2.0!  
During the rewriting, we encountered a bunch of unexpected programming problems resulting in the extension of our timeline...
So thank you all so much for being patient and supporting along the way. 
Soon we will be celebrating the traditional Chinese New Year (Spring Festival) during which we are on sale 30% off.
Do have fun and kick the bosses ass in the new year.

Juicy Realm update list:

 About Weapons

1.Having the weapon system fully rewritten, the upper limit of ammunition was canceled. There are three classification of weapons such as Loading weapons, Charging weapons or Powering-up weapons. Charging ones require a charging time to attack. After fully powering up, powering-up weapons may gain an extra ability.
2.Add weapon reinforcement system, allowing player to customize their own weapon.  
3.Bosses may drop fruit cores to unlock new weapons at the basement.
4.The number of weapons are up to 80.


 About Characters

1.Expand the difference between different characters, Alpha can revive twice and summon Pea Popper, Ponpon can activate an auto regenerating shield and can stun nearby enemies, Emy can reduce cooldown when attacking enemies and owns bullets that track enemies, The ninja can rapidly regen energy and summon a shadow.
2.Build the character cultivation system, use fruit cores to reinforce the character permanently.
3.Add a pet system, meet pet shop in the map.


 About Battling

1.An elite monster will be in the middle of each level.
2.Add a altar for hardcore mode daily.
3.Boss can be directly attacked, but the effect doubles when attacked on weak point.
4.Interactive items and land affect updated for each level. (e.g.bouncing ball or bullet effecting land)


 About Maps

1.Several types of map including battle rooms, chest rooms, random event rooms, structure rooms, weapon shop rooms, pet shop rooms will combine randomly.
2.Players are allowed to go in and our in the level. Mini map informs players with details of the map.

For more information about Juicy Realm, please follow us on Facebook and Twitter any time:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/JuicyRealm
Twitter: https://twitter.com/JuicyRealm

Any bugs and feedbacks needed to report? Feel free to contact us with e-mail: juicyrealm@xindong.com
